heading: Budgets
subtitle: Recurring spend policies, accounting records and manual reconciliation.
enforceNote: Enforced budgets reserve estimated output cost. Actual cost may exceed the reservation and the limit; exhausted accounts reject new requests. Soft budgets record spend without blocking requests.
accountingNote: Committed spend, reservations and unknown charges are different facts. Overlapping scope accounts must not be added together as total consumption. Accounting records, not asynchronous usage reports, are the reconciliation source.
quotaNote: A budget's available amount is not the legacy prepaid quota balance. The quota page reports that balance separately. No currency conversion is performed.
reservedNote: Reserved includes holds for unknown charges; do not add unknown estimates again. See the reconciliation view for individual unknown reservations. Period times below are shown in UTC.
unknownNote: Unknown means the upstream charge could not be confirmed. Its reservation remains held until reconciliation. Risk-released records still have unknown cost and can later be settled with evidence.
eventNote: Event amounts have no currency snapshot in this API and are explicitly marked currency unknown. Do not infer a currency or sum these amounts. Times are shown in UTC.
startsNow: This policy starts when created. It does not reconstruct earlier spend from incomplete usage history. Weeks start on Monday in the selected IANA timezone.
editNote: Only the limit and enabled state can change. Existing committed spend and reservations are retained; enabling or disabling does not reset the period. This update checks the displayed version.
riskTitle: Release an unknown charge at your risk?
riskNote: This releases held funds without establishing that the request was free. The cost remains unknown. A later evidenced settlement can still debit the actual charge. Your identity, reason and evidence are recorded.
releaseNote: Release only with evidence confirming no charge. This is not an automatic refund for a timeout or a missing usage response. Your identity, reason and evidence are recorded.
settleNote: Record the evidenced total actual cost, not a delta. This may make available funds negative. Your identity, reason and evidence are recorded, and the record version is checked.
actualHint: Enter the total actual cost in the reservation's currency, not an additional charge. The backend calculates any remaining difference.
evidenceHint: Use a billing reference or a concise description of evidence. Do not include request/response bodies, credentials or personal data.
invalidAmount: Enter a valid decimal amount within the supported safe integer range.
forbiddenRead: You do not have permission to read budgets.
forbiddenWrite: Only a global operator with the required budget permission can perform this operation.
loadError: Budgets could not be loaded. Check the selected tenant and your access, then retry. No empty or zero balance is inferred from this error.
selectTenant: Select a tenant to view budgets.
selectTenantHint: Global operators must explicitly choose a tenant before reading or changing accounting records.
tenantName: Tenant name (including names outside the dropdown)
legacyBalance: Tenant prepaid quota balance (separate from period budgets)
legacyUnknown: Balance not established: no currency snapshot is available. This does not imply a zero balance or unlimited funds.
accountsSubtitle: Current and historical period accounts. Late settlement stays in the original period.
emptyPolicies: No budget policies for this tenant.
emptyEvents: No budget events on this page.
emptyAccountsHint: Accounts are created lazily when a request first reserves against this policy.
scopeRefHint: Use the decimal ID of the group or application belonging to this tenant, not its name. Group refers to the consuming group, not the application's owner group.
keyRefHint: Use the key ID, never the secret API key. The key must belong to this tenant.
thresholdHint: Comma-separated distinct integer percentages from 1 to 100. Thresholds use committed spend, not reservations.
